name: RHEL Splunk threat-hunting candidates and gaps
description: Unvalidated hunt candidates, context-only signals, and telemetry gaps. Uncolored techniques are unassessed. Colors do not represent verified detections.

metadata.name: Reviewed source
metadata.value: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise STIX v20.1, reviewed 2026-11-05

techniques.comment: Candidate only. Sysmon process and PowerShell telemetry require live validation.
Candidate only. Confirm a Security 4720 account is local and creation is unauthorized.
Candidate only. Confirm the group SID, its privilege, and the actor's authorization.
Candidate only. Task creation or modification does not by itself prove execution or abuse.
Candidate only for the specifically monitored SIEMLab Run-key pattern, not all Run keys or Startup folders.
Candidate only. Verify the System 104 provider and investigate authorization and independently retained evidence.
Candidate only. Repeated failures before success do not establish password guessing or compromise.
Candidate only. Multi-account failures do not establish that the same password was used.
Context only. Authentication activity does not prove a valid account was used by an adversary.
Context only. A selected process connection is not protocol-level evidence of command and control.
Context only. DNS is filtered to PowerShell, and a DNS query alone is not C2 evidence.
Context only. Local SSH authentication is not proof of adversarial lateral movement.
Gap: mail and attachment delivery telemetry are not provided.
Gap: cloud account lifecycle and identity audit events are not collected.
Gap: cloud role-assignment audit data is not collected.
Gap: EDR memory access or Sysmon process-access telemetry is not configured.
Gap: remote WMI activity is not fully observable from process starts alone.
Gap: share auditing and correlated source/destination Windows telemetry are not configured.
Gap: local authentication syslog is insufficient to identify Linux log tampering.
Gap: general file-read evidence is not provided by the limited lab FileCreate rule.
Gap: complete egress and transfer context and a confirmed C2 channel are unavailable.
Gap: broad file-change, ransomware behavior, and backup-impact telemetry are not provided.
